detectionPolicy: Read-only discovery. The library never reads game memory, injects code, modifies game files, or applies undocumented vendor/driver settings.

games.name: Counter-Strike 2
focus: Measure in-game frame times with the game's own telemetry or a trusted overlay.
Review Windows Game Mode, capture, and per-game graphics preferences manually.

games.name: Rust
focus: Watch memory pressure and shader/cache behavior during a repeatable route.
No process priority or memory registry tweak is applied.

games.name: VALORANT
focus: Keep anti-cheat and Riot services intact.
Use the game's own latency and frame-time settings.

games.name: Fortnite
focus: Compare DX12/Performance mode and shader compilation in a consistent workload.
No global shader-cache deletion is performed.

games.name: Apex Legends
focus: Use a repeatable practice range and record frame-time percentiles.
No anti-cheat-sensitive process manipulation is performed.

games.name: Call of Duty / Warzone
focus: Use in-game benchmark or telemetry when available.

games.name: Escape from Tarkov
focus: Monitor available memory and repeat the same map/route for comparison.
No automatic page-file or process-priority change is made.

games.name: PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS
focus: Measure 1% lows and frame times in a repeatable match or replay.
No system-wide network tweak is applied.

games.name: Rainbow Six Siege
focus: Choose the renderer and graphics options in the game.

games.name: Overwatch
focus: Use the in-game frame-rate and latency indicators for repeatable comparisons.

games.name: Grand Theft Auto V
